scope: classify one BLS post-release API availability sample and determine its effect on Gate E and the disabled BLS freshness candidate

decisions.basis: The official calendar schedules the September CPI release for October 14, 2026 at 08:30 Eastern. The single official API request on October 28 at 20:52 Eastern returned HTTP 200, REQUEST_SUCCEEDED, and included period 2026-09.
limitations: The capture occurred 14 days 12 hours after the scheduled release, not at the scheduled minute.
It proves availability by capture time only; first availability time and release latency are unknown.
One sample does not establish a repeated availability threshold or support the proposed exact 60-day override.

decisions.basis: The observation was made at 2026-10-28 20:52 EDT, before the scheduled October 29 U.S. local release date. No Census API request was sent in this step.

remaining_evidence: One tracked Census ACS1 availability observation after its scheduled October 29, 2026 U.S. local release time.
